description: Declarative ZFS profile of repository-owned datasets that need more than the TrueNAS APPS preset. Reconciled by scripts/truenas/bootstrap-repository-storage.sh (--check reports drift, --apply converges through the middleware). Snapshot classes stay in snapshot-tasks.json.

media.purpose: *arr media library and torrents. One dataset so qBittorrent and Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr can hardlink and move atomically (docs/arr-media-library-roadmap.md section 7).

ntopng.purpose: ntopng RRD time series and its Redis: about 400 small writes/s on 16/11, each rewriting a 128K record. Existing files keep 128K records until rewritten with ntopng stopped (docs/roadmap.md, TrueNAS performance plan item 1).
